scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Welcome to Morocc,
the frontier town of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
Please ask me for help if
you're having any trouble
finding anything in town.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
歡迎來到夢羅克，盧恩·米德加茲王國的邊境城鎮。
如果在城裡找不到想去的地方，請隨時向我求助。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在您的小地圖上標記地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:

請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Thief Guild is
in charge of all Job
Changes to the Thief
Class. From what I hear,
you can find them inside
the Pyramids nearby...
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
盜賊公會負責辦理盜賊的轉職手續。
聽說他們就在附近的金字塔裡...

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Weapon Shop
is in the southeast
end of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
武器店位於夢羅克的東南端。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
There are Inns
where you can rest
at the southeast and
northeast ends of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
夢羅克的東南端和東北端都有旅館，您可以在那裡休息。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]

Pub in northeast Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
酒館位於夢羅克東北部。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Mercenary
Guild is located
in East Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
傭兵公會位於夢羅克東部。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
The Forge is
located just
southwest from
the center of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[夢羅克嚮導]
鍛造所位於夢羅克市中心的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Morocc Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.

[夢羅克嚮導]
如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

[Morocc Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you

location marks displayed

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
魔法與科技的進步讓我們得以更新資訊系統，現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，方便您辨認方向。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在夢羅克遊歷愉快。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Guide]
Alright then,
try to stay out of
too much trouble
out there, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克嚮導]
好了，冒險者，在外面小心些，儘量別惹上太多麻煩。
